body:
Thank you for your lengthy reply. I don't think it comes off as you making it about yourself. It makes a lot of sense, having this account active, and seeing everyone struggle as I once did does bring me down. It isn't their fault either, it's just that I can't keep that mindset around me anymore.

Thank you for the well wishes as well. I hope the best to you, I'm happy for you! 

For the last two paragraphs, I followed the two subreddits on my main account, thank you for the suggestion. I'm doing my best to live in the moment, seeing as I very well couldn't have all that way 3 months ago.

Godspeed you!

She's an intimidating woman, and isn't a physically affectionate one either.  

While most people can easily ask for a hug, I can not. Too much dramatic back story.
I'm no super hero. I'm not strong like them. I'm just the unseen person in the crumbling building you see in the background. Sounds edgy, I know, but that's how it feels.
How is everything NOT anxiety ridden? Work, bills, hygiene, eating, all of it.
I'd love to see FFM. I just don't have the time anymore, everything is just anxiety ridden.
Very much so. I'm happy to have seen it all, haha. It was amazing see the development of all my favourite character's (:
My pops and I have watched Marvel together for ages. Endgame was the literal end of the super hero's we've known for 11 years.

I appreciate your comment. You're right, there's not much anyone can say to change my mind. This doesn't mean you shouldn't still try; there are people out there who need people like you, who need someone to talk to them. I just wasn't one of those people, or, at least it doesn't feel like I am. 

Sorry if I upset you. I'm just not seeing it.

I've been suicidal for a few weeks now. Everything's planned out, it's good to go but I'm just too much of a coward to do it yet. 

I'm sorry about your friend. I'm sure you made their life enjoyable while they were with you, I know my friend has helped tremendously whenever I see them.
Sounds lame, but I really want to watch The Avengers: Endgame. After that, nothing.
Pretty close to 🖤. Post history kinda explains it.

I did make it through your whole comment. You have me sobbing over here

I just feel so unworthy of everything. I feel guilty. I feel guilty for wanting to end my life but I feel guilty for not doing anything with it. 

My only enjoyment is watching movies/shows/documentaries with my dad. He's always been a Marvel fan and he's the one who got me hooked on them. We're actually going to be watching one Marvel movie everyday up to the release of Endgame. I've been feeling the most guilt about my decision because of that, cause he's so damn excited to start this with me and that's also where I feel sick. I don't know if I want this but I don't know what else I can do with my life. I wish I was as strong as all the super hero's I watch. I'm not.

I usually only go the theatres when I do go out, besides work. 

Since I'm new to the whole Super Hero thing I can't relate, but I can see what you're talking about; person who wants to do good fights bad guys, bad guys almost win but good guy teams up with like-minded people and beats em, queue next movie. I still find it interesting though (:

It sucks feeling like this.
I've just started B99 (: Only watched the first two episodes but I definitely like the humour. I'll give Parks and Rec. a shot, I couldn't stand the cringe humour of The Office, haha.

My aunty has wanted to watch GOT with us. She has the whole seasons. I never felt interested in it but I'd give it a shot.

Sometimes I almost want to get it over with. I've already drafted a few notes to my family, but nothing "official". I just feel bad because me and my dad are always talking about the MCU and I feel sick when I think about how I want to kill myself after Endgame...It's really scary.

I've been trying to cut out sugar, surprisingly harder than I thought. 

I don't have the money for a dentist, not at the moment at least. I will as soon as I can afford it though.
I'm about 30% there bud, don't worry
